description: This file defines a utility enum 'VoiceWakePreferences' in Swift that manages voice wake trigger words. It provides functions for decoding JSON payloads, loading/saving trigger words using UserDefaults, sanitizing input, and generating display strings. The enum appears to be used for managing voice wake preferences within the application.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from:)
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into an array of trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: Data)
methods.description: Decodes a Data object containing JSON into an array of trigger words.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords(defaults:)
methods.description: Loads trigger words from UserDefaults or returns default trigger words.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords(_:)
methods.description: Sanitizes a list of trigger words by trimming whitespace, filtering out empty strings, limiting count, and truncating length.

methods.name: displayString(for:)
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of sanitized trigger words for display.
